`program_plan_roundtrip.rs` discards non-`continuation` fields on `StageOutcome::Waiting { continuation, .. }`, does not persist external output files during the test run (`DATA-ONLY-COMPARISONS.json` `/planActualFullOutcomeCaptured` = `false`), and stops at the `receipt` await boundary without calling `stage::resume` on the conditional suffix (`CONDITIONAL-RESUME.json`).

In `utxo_pattern_exchange.rs`, `Step.statement` (`ExprId` indices `2, 5, 8, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15, 18, 21, 22`) and `Step.value` are checked only against `authored.expected.json` (`/notAsserted` in `SEMANTIC-PREMISES-AND-LIMITS.json`), and the independent oracle's balance/liability array order uses a disclosed non-numeric sorting fact from `runtime.rs` (`SEMANTIC-PREMISES-AND-LIMITS.json` `/presentationPremise/sourceFactOnly`).

`financial_program_wire_contract.rs` consumes only the 2 frozen `Program` JSON fixtures (`installment-invoice.program.expected.json` and `conditional-reserve.program.expected.json`) out of the 32 files in the prior financial freeze packet, and its public `Program` / `v1::Program` deserialization checks test shared-codec roundtrip consistency rather than additional independent oracles.
